command_or_source: Tests/TestRunner.swift temporary SQLite providers database plus temporary Codex config; separate read-only production catalog probe using CodexModelSwitchService against the current CC Switch Anker Provider.
result_summary: The temporary integration switches both stores to v_model/gpt-6-astra while preserving Provider auth/other JSON, non-model TOML, and 0600 permissions. The production read-only probe reached https://ai-router.anker-in.com/v1/models and returned 45 unique models including Sol and Astra without modifying either production configuration.
limitations: The production probe read the live Provider credential only in memory and did not print it, modify configuration, or select a model.
The integration does not claim that every returned Anker model is compatible with Codex /responses.
